'''Messert''' was a celestial body located in the [[Messert system/Legends|Messert system]], a part of the [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region's]] [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Randon Run/Legends|Randon Run]] linked it to the [[Chamble system/Legends|Chamble]] and [[Randon system/Legends|Randon systems]]. Messert was a financial hub of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]], and loans from it financed several [[Mining/Legends|mining]], industrial, and agricultural ventures in the Kashyyyk Region.<ref name="TEA" /> The astronomical object shared its name with the offworld company [[Messert Mines Corporation]].<ref name="Planets">''[[The Star Wars Planets Collection]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The name "Messert" was introduced in the form of a mention of the Messert Mines Corporation in the [[1991]] [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One]]''.<ref name="Planets1">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], was the first source to describe Messert as a celestial body and placed it in grid square Q-10.<ref name="TEA" />
